runtimeSuggestions.reason: For documented residential 25% radius reduction, the item rMin is the lowest unreduced table radius; it must not clamp the pressure-specific reduced minimum.

Selected PRS30/PRS40 body caps nozzle working pressure at nominal regulator output, including manual pressure edits. Regulator cannot boost an insufficient upstream supply. Do not confuse the 1–7 bar body inlet operating range with nozzle regulated outlet.

Reduced-radius unchanged flow, if retained, must be labelled modelling assumption; published precipitation remains tied to full table throw and table layout. No universal manufacturer unchanged-flow guarantee established.
